notes.title: A Better "HD" Version
notes.notes:
This is the first major update after releasing Football Drama "HD". It features a major improvement: the readability of all texts that are now "sharper", in particular texts that are not black or white. 

Another nice new feature is the hints for the controller mapping:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/21b89b5f3818a1e1454061c79f77c67a4eee6641.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/21b89b5f3818a1e1454061c79f77c67a4eee6641.gif[/img][/url]

In the meantime, Football Drama has gone through  Nintendo certification for the Nintendo Switch (coming out this week!), and this led to fixing several minor bugs:
[list]
[*] Several fixes to localization (German, Russian, Chinese).
[*] More robust to random tapping.
[/list]
You also will find more variety in press meetings. Remember the new auto speed up option in settings!

P.S. Also with 40% discount until the 5th of May!

notes.title: Football Drama “HD” — Major Update Released!
notes.notes:
You can now update Football Drama and get a full-featured version built for desktops: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/1143d797a4ec5153d1ac6f3a48e9577823ebb383.gif[/img]

This is a big update for desktop users, as with this the entire application layouts have been redesigned to use the whole landscape mode space. We hope you’ll appreciate the new layouts! 

Moreover, you can play with a controller (or even keyboard):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/ba01ae61421dcbcc87aef0dd3474715032cca257.png[/img]

This release also includes several feature updates.

One nice new feature that we found can improve a lot the gameplay experience for some players is the “sped up mode”, available in Settings, that speeds up the matches gameplay so that the flow from deciding between a cautious and a risky move is quicker. This option also removes the enter fields animations and the replays after the first championship week.

We have a new “night mode” - some matches are played in the evenings. We also introduced some post-processing for the graphics of the whole application, and you can see both effects in action here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/3044bababc4864dbf80041b143647d5ea6f5be2d.gif[/img]

There also some bug fixes and a new badge, that you may get when you meet a journalist and the major plot is revealed...
A reference to periodical football corruption scandals that are one of the distinguishing features of this sport.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/25156622832dda9ca852930029e28460bb1c8323.jpg[/img]

(By the way [url=https://www.open-lab.com/achievements/footballDrama/]here[/url] is the custom achievement site that we've built for Football Drama.)

And the future? We are now building a content expansion update (first quarter 2021), together with a Japanese language version and Nintendo Switch release. All this will be a free update for Steam users.

Last but not least, Steam Winter Sale is coming...

notes.title: Football Drama "HD" update in development (Steam / Switch)
notes.notes:
Since we got the "ok" for Football Drama's Switch version, we will create a special version of Football Drama for HD resolutions. This will be both an update of the Steam version and the version released on the Switch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/38899e6a16993d68c265f0b4e27899569304535e.jpg[/img]

We may also add a Japanese translation in the occasion. \\o/

notes.title: First Football Drama Update: Speed Up!
notes.notes:
So we just went live with our first Football Drama update. 

We are sorry for the two bugs, they would not have occurred if we had a cross platform cross language testing team, but being two guys that try to do everything (marketing and support too) we do what we can. So THANKS for the users who reported them in detail so we could fix them. 
Football Drama is also doing very well on mobile, on [url=https://apps.apple.com/app/football-drama/id1401903505]App Store (iOS)[/url] and [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.openlab.footballdrama]Google Play (Android)[/url], thanks for that too.

These are the improvements/changes/fixes:
[list]
[*] We added a tutorial step in the second half to tell about the "tap or click in the field centre" just after you made a choice in the match that speeds up the whole thing. For players that like faster matches, it changes the whole feeling of the game.
[*] We removed the (sometimes repetitive) meeting with the president when nothing crucial is happening (i.e. he is not furious, you are not fired, you didn't win the championship). This too seems a small change but makes the whole flow more natural.
[*] We did a lot of improvements in the translation, in particular in French (Charlene Lebrun), Italian (Luca Papale), Chinese (Melanie Luo), Russian.
[*] BUG FIX: We fixed a bug in the rendering of the German and Russian Oracle dialogue that crashed the game.
[*] BUG FIX: There was an occasional problem in saving the state of matches (not involving you) of the current week.
[/list]
So we hope you enjoy the game even more \o/

notes.title: Praparing first patch / update
notes.notes:
Just a little note to say that we have survived day 1 from launch, we are listening to all your feedback, positive and negative, and we will announce what is going to go in the first update soon, and we hope to release an update next week. 
Very happy that up to now there seem to be no major bugs or crashes: fingers crossed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/6d6950e65ebaedc92611f8e31b20eef407eed72b.jpg[/img]
Yes some little language fixes too.

notes.title: Football Drama Soundtrack DLC Available On Release
notes.notes:
Football Drama has an original soundtrack that reflects and inspires the atmospheres of the game. The composer and main performer is [url=https://www.facebook.com/ascari.composer]Ascari[/url] (Marta Ascari) who worked closely with the designers and Football Drama's concept in order to create a work aligned with the game's intended meaning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228816/13fabe01508b60fb56b0555cebb1e303efd0a066.jpg[/img]

Ascari involved several musicians (as detailed in the soundtrack page) with research and studio recordings in order to maximize the resulting quality.

The soundtrack includes a song with Marta as the singer (and composer) that refers to a crucial theme of the narrative, with words from Football Drama's game designer Pietro Polsinelli.

You can buy the soundtrack as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1132350/Football_Drama__Soundtrack/]Football Drama's DLC here[/url].
